items.t: United Airlines (UAL) Opens 14 Gate Concourse E At Dulles After Two Decades
items.sum: United Airlines Holdings (NasdaqGS:UAL) has opened the new Concourse E at Washington Dulles International Airport, the airport's first new concourse in nearly twenty years. The new facility adds 14 gates to United's Dulles hub, along with expanded United Club spaces and upgraded customer amenities.
